notes: Real agency-founder leads pulled from the gigradar-outreach `leads` collection. Each is a service agency (GigRadar's ICP) with a live website, spanning different niches to exercise opportunity-mining, the earnings niche table, and case-study tag matching.

evals.prompt: Build a custom GigRadar Upwork opportunity-map proposal for this lead who replied to our cold outreach: Abed Adawi, Founder & Partner at AB Marketing Group (abmarketinggroup.co). Produce a self-contained proposal.html.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained proposal.html: personalized hero (his photo+logo), their services, ~9 cherry-picked high-value Upwork jobs in marketing/lead-gen, profile mockup, earnings calculator (lead-gen niche), relevant case studies (marketing/lead-gen tags), HubSpot demo modal.

evals.prompt: Create the custom opportunity-map proposal for Abubakar Shams, CEO & Co-Founder of Phaedra Solutions (phaedrasolutions.com) — he replied to our outreach. Self-contained HTML.
evals.expected_output: Proposal.html tuned to software/dev: dev/data Upwork jobs, software-development case studies (COXIT, Disoft, Kandisa, DestiLabs), software niche calculator defaults.

evals.prompt: Make the lead magnet proposal page for Aaron Chapman, Founder & Executive Producer at Neuvant Studios (neuvantstudios.com). They're interested. One HTML file.

evals.prompt: Build the custom GigRadar proposal for Amanda Woiner at Epic Web Studios (epicwebstudios.com), Director of Digital Marketing — replied to our sequence. Self-contained page.
